title: zenbu.language-data-releases.v1
description: The bucket's releases.json: every published language-data release, oldest first (issue 463). Written by language-data/pipeline/publish.py after a release's files and manifest are uploaded. Entries are only ever appended. Release IDs increasing in order is checked by publish.py.

release.description: The release ID, YYYY.MM.N. Its manifest is releases/<release>/manifest.json.

manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the manifest.json bytes as published.

git_commit.description: The commit the release was packaged from: the manifest's git_commit.

published_at.description: When the entry was added, in UTC.
